function.name: list_projects
function.description: Lists all available projects in 10x Genomics Cloud Analysis.

function.name: list_runs
function.description: Lists analysis runs. Can be filtered by a specific project ID.

project_id.description: The ID of the project to filter runs by. If omitted, lists runs from all projects.

function.name: get_run
function.description: Retrieves the details for a specific analysis run by its ID.

run_id.description: The unique identifier of the run to retrieve.
